dc_eval_cbrn.note: Only content-safety 'dangerous content' policy evals (Sec 6.4.1); no CBRN uplift evaluation; defers to Gemini 1.0 report.

dc_eval_cyber.note: No offensive cyber evaluation; memorization divergence attack (6.5) is training-data extraction, not cyber capability.

framework_threshold.note: No safety framework named; only Google AI Principles and Responsibility and Safety Council review.

ext_test_any.quote: In addition, we are continuing to conduct evaluations on other modality areas (e.g. audio-to-text and video-to-text) whilst undertaking red teaming and external evaluations.
ext_test_any.note: External evaluations of Gemini 1.5 Pro stated, no results, no org, no timing; not stated to be post-release, so counts under timing rule. Borderline.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: External evaluations described as ongoing ('continuing to conduct'); no pre-deployment timing stated for outside testing.

safeguards_training.quote: Our modeling mitigation of safety risks is mostly through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF) using a reward model
safeguards_training.note: Safety SFT and RLHF, plus new image-to-text safety SFT data.

safeguards_runtime.note: 'monitoring' refers to evaluating long inputs' effect on safety and to product-site operational docs; no runtime classifier/filter named.

safeguards_access.note: Known Caveats says model should not be deployed without downstream safety assessment; this is guidance, not an access restriction.
